messages:
maya (pm): Heads-up — I'm proposing a 'slimline' flow for low-risk model entries: short shadow onboarding + soft deprecation runway. Goal: make migrations predictable for customers while keeping ops overhead low. Planning: 6-week runway: 2w shadow, 2w staggered canaries, 2w soft-deprecation opt-in. Need decisions on cohort selection, pin grace windows, rollback criteria, and comms.
hao (eng): +1 to a short runway for small models. Can we define pass/fail metrics for the canaries? latency + token-cost + regressions on eval set?
sarah (sre): We need SLO guardrails. Suggest thresholds: p95 latency delta < 20%, error rate < 0.5% absolute, infra CPU/GPU mem < 80% sustained. Also alerting playbook linked to rollback.
leo (support): Support needs a clear customer-facing script for opt-in and opt-out, and a list of affected customers (pinned vs unpinned). If someone is pinned we should auto-exempt unless they request migration.
amelia (prod-ops): For comms: short email + in-console banner + scheduled migration window. Offer a 2-week pin grace (customer stays on pinned model), then optional auto-migrate if they opt in. For incentives: small credit for early migrations?
hao (eng): For canary cohorts, pick 3 buckets: 1) internal shadow (0%), 2) opt-in customers (~5%), 3) open canary (incremental +5% each day up to 20%). This lets us watch quality before broad rollout.
maya (pm): Agree. Also want a 'soft-deprecation' mode: after runway ends, we stop new requests to old model except for pinned customers and a final escape hatch for enterprise customers for 30 days.
sarah (sre): Add auto-fallback: if we detect quality regressions (eval mismatch > threshold) or infra issues, route traffic to fallback variant. Need to define fallback priority (same family, lower-latency variant, etc.).
hao (eng): Example gating snippet for canary automation:
```
canary_policy:
  shadow_run: 14d
  canary_windows:
    - cohort: internal
      pct: 0
    - cohort: opt_in
      pct: 5
      duration: 7d
    - cohort: ramp
      start_pct: 5
      max_pct: 20
      step: 5
      step_interval: 24h
  metrics:
    - name: p95_latency
      max_relative_increase: 0.20
    - name: error_rate
      max_absolute: 0.005
    - name: eval_delta
      max_absolute: 0.02
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: eval_delta
    gt: 0.03
  - metric: error_rate
    gt: 0.01
```
leo (support): That snippet is helpful. Can we also include a quick CLI snippet to list customers in opt-in cohort?
hao (eng): Sure: `rcli catalog cohorts list --model-id <id> --cohort opt_in`
maya (pm): Comms draft idea: short subject "Upcoming model migration window: <model-name>" with bullets: why, windows, opt-in instructions, credits, contact. Keep tone: "no unexpected changes for pinned customers." Include FAQ: how to request extended pin.
amelia (prod-ops): Timeline proposal: Week 0: comms sent + shadow start; Week 2: internal canary review; Week 3-4: opt-in + ramping canaries; Week 5-6: soft-deprecation + final opt-in; Week 7: deprecate for non-pinned.
sarah (sre): Ops checklist: pre-shadow perf baseline, tracing hooks enabled, eval-run daily, alerts set, rollback playbook staged, incident channel pre-created.
leo (support): I'll prep the support playbook and canned messages. Need product to confirm credit amount before I finalize customer emails.
maya (pm): Decision items for this week:
- approve metrics and rollback thresholds (hao + sarah)
- confirm cohort percentages and timing (hao + amelia)
- finalize comms copy and incentive (maya + leo)
- exempt pinned customers by default (product)
If we can sign these off by EOD Friday we can start shadow next Tuesday.
hao (eng): I'll validate thresholds with perf team and post numbers by Thursday.
sarah (sre): I can own the rollout runbook and will create the incident channel now.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: `canary-run 1767778123 --model <redwood/model-slm-slimline> --policy canary_policy_v1` :robot_face:
maya (pm): Thanks — tagging @hao @sarah @leo @amelia for visibility. If anyone has objections to the 6-week slimline runway, speak now. Otherwise we'll proceed with signoffs and start the shadow run next Tue.
hao (eng): No objections from eng.
leo (support): No objections; will align support coverage.
amelia (prod-ops): Good to go from ops.
sarah (sre): 👍 ready.
maya (pm): Great — closing thread. I'll post final comms + signoff summary here once done. :tada:
